phase: Accounting Spine / F4 BNR CNF annual-2025 stock trigger monitoring
purpose: Separate a legitimate future stock-only F4 reopen trigger from the already exhausted quarterly/reference-mode source paths. The BNR annual National Financial Accounts counterpart matrix is semantically adequate for year-end stock counterpart allocation when it covers the target year, even though annual stock-only data remain inadequate for quarterly stock+transaction reference-mode recovery.

governing_current_state.unresolved_stock_boundary: BNR-holder F4 asset stock totals 6.1 million RON at 2025-Q4 but is not allocated across H/C/F/G/X.

retained_bnr_cnf_evidence.prior_reference_mode_rejection_reason: Annual single stock snapshot lacks the frozen quarterly stock+financial-transaction history.
retained_bnr_cnf_evidence.interpretation: That frequency rejection does not disqualify a same-year annual counterpart matrix from a stock-only F4 identification gate.

publication_cadence_evidence.inference: The preceding reports use end-October of the following year as their stated data-availability cutoff. Therefore a 2025 counterpart report should not be presumed available before the corresponding 2026 evidence window; this is a monitoring inference, not a guaranteed publication date.

current_public_review.target_matrix: BNR National Financial Accounts counterpart stocks, reference year 2025

trigger_satisfied_when: An official BNR National Financial Accounts publication or machine-readable table exposes the year-end 2025 non-consolidated counterpart stock matrix.
The reporting/source sector S121 is separately identifiable.
AF4/F4 assets for S121 are broken down by counterpart sectors that map exactly to H, C, F, G, X and BNR or can be combined by exact additive identities.
The published counterpart values reconcile to the retained 2025-Q4 BNR total F4 asset stock within the frozen source-appropriate accounting tolerance.
No residual-share allocation, interpolation or missing-to-zero rule is required.

monitoring_policy.date_semantics: Evidence-window marker inferred from prior report data cutoffs, not a promised BNR publication date.
valid_new_evidence: official BNR catalogue update explicitly exposing the 2025 S121×counterpart AF4 stock table
